options.text: Yes, I would like some rope.

options.text: How did you get back from Crandor?

steps.player: How did you get back from Crandor?

steps.npc: I got towed back by a passing friendly whale.
Anyway, would you like me to make some rope while you're here?

options.text: Can you take me to Crandor again?

steps.npc: Aye, that I could. I'll meet you at the Port Sarim docks again. I'll try to steer a little better this time!

steps.player: Thanks. Hmmm, do you know something? This rope has a funny smell.
Yes, It reminds me of...yaks. I was travelling in the Fremennik Isles recently and, do you know what? They made rope out of yak's hair.
There was a lady over there who sold wool, she said she traded rope for the wool.
I don't think you make rope at all. I think you trade balls of wool for rope.

steps.npc: Oh, I confess. You have found the truth. I used to make the rope myself, but my fingers aren't as nimble as they used to be and so many people wanted my rope. Demand was so high I had to find another
source. But I couldn't tell anyone since Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) is a high profile brand now.

steps.player: Yes, well, the wool is still pretty good, though yak hair makes fine rope. I don't suppose any harm will come of it.

steps.npc: Thanks. Here take this, a free sample! Please, don't tell anyone.

steps.player: Well, it's always good to keep on the good side of a sailor. Your secret is safe with me.
